actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Segment action with a HTTP request.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: send_event
actions.title: Send event
actions.help: First select the event you would like to send. After selecting the event, fill in any relevant input fields related to that event.

input.name: source
input.label: Source
input.hint: Fully qualified source name. For example, workspaces/acme/sources/javascript

input.name: destination
input.label: Destination
input.hint: Provide the destinations separated by comma that you want to send event. By default, event will be send to all destinations that are enabled.

input.name: events
input.label: Event type
input.hint: Provide the event type. Allowed values are alias , track , identify , group , screen , page .

actions.name: send_event_batch
actions.title: Send events
actions.help: First select the event you would like to send. After selecting the event, fill in any relevant input fields related to that event. This action will allow up to 200 records.

input.name: source
input.label: Source
input.hint: Fully qualified source name. For example, workspaces/acme/sources/javascript

input.name: destination
input.label: Destination
input.hint: Provide the destinations separated by comma that you want to send event. By default, events will be send to all destinations that are enabled.

input.name: events
input.label: Event type
input.hint: Provide the event type. Allowed values are alias , track , identify , group , screen , page .
